meta.method: candidates: TAG-vs-eRail route alignment (same position, identical times), datameet near-duplicates, and retired datameet codes (near a TAG station, terminal name search, or datameet-2016 vs eRail same-train position). Accepted only with two independent pieces of evidence among: datameet-vs-ConfirmTkt coordinates within 1 km, exact normalised names, route position. Rejected: > 5 km apart; both codes live on ConfirmTkt unless a retired pair has datameet-vs-eRail route evidence and either identical ConfirmTkt names or >= 2 train pairs.
